author: paper-design
name: halftone-dots
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Halftone Dots style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#111111, #525252, #D4D4D4, #FAFAFA). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
